button: a row of button styles: primary 'Start free trial', 'Book a demo', secondary, destructive 'Delete workspace' and a theme icon button. The full button set; Action button is one toolbar button.
action-button: one black pill toolbar button with an icon and the label 'Export invoices'. A single compact button; Button shows the whole set of styles.
dropdown-menu: a 'Review actions' trigger button with its open menu listing Approve and Request changes. A trigger plus menu; Split button joins the menu to a primary action.
split-button: a primary action button joined to a chevron that opens a menu of alternatives. Pick it over Dropdown menu when one action is the default.
button-group: two joined segments 'Approve' and 'Request changes' with hairline dividers and an attached menu. Joined buttons; Floating button group keeps them separate.
tooltip: a small icon button with a dark tooltip above it. The smallest Arc frame; Popover holds richer content.
floating-button-group: separate soft icon buttons in a tray (Archive, Edit, Bookmark) with a tooltip over one. Pick it over Button group when the buttons should float apart.
expanding-button-group: a compact row of icon buttons where one is widened to show its label 'Copy link', next to Email and Delete. Icons with one labelled; Toggle group has no labels.
theme-switch: four 'Switch theme' buttons with sun and moon icons, one per transition style (reveal, eclipse, split, rise). The only light/dark control.
popover: a round 'Add reaction' trigger button with its popover. A trigger only; Reactions shows the full emoji bar with counts.
reactions: a row of emoji reaction chips with counts (2, 4, 6, 3) and an add-reaction button. Social reactions under a post.
icon-morph: a single small icon button, one state of a morphing icon. The icon alone; Confirm morph is a full destructive button.
confirm-morph: a destructive 'Remove teammate' button, the first state of a confirm flow. Pick it for a delete action; Button shows generic styles.
swipe-actions: two inbox rows (Maya Chen, Jonas Weber) with their message previews and an action layer behind one row. A mail list; Reorderable list is a task list with drag handles.
input: labelled text fields: Name 'Emma Collins', Work email, with a helper line. Plain text inputs; Sign up form is a complete form.
password-strength: a 'Create password' field with masked dots, an eye icon, four rule lines ticked and a 'Strong' label. The only password meter.
money-input: an 'Annual contract value' field reading $48,000.00 USD with +$1,000 and +$5,000 quick-add chips. Currency entry; Number field is a plain stepper.
otp-input: a 'Verification code' row of six digit boxes (4 8 2 9 1 5) under 'Sent to maya.chen@northwind.app'. The only one-time-code field.
tag-input: a 'Labels' field holding three removable tags: billing, enterprise, q3-renewal. Free-text tags; Chip group is fixed filter chips.
number-field: a 'Seats' field at 25 with minus and plus step buttons and a 'Billed' note. Integer stepper; Money input is for currency.
inline-edit: a project title 'Northwind Mobile Redesign' with its description line, shown as plain text ready to rename. Pick it for rename-in-place; Input shows boxed fields.
phone-input: a 'Mobile number' field with a US flag and +1 country picker and '(415) 555-0142'. The only phone field.
select: a closed select field reading 'EU West (Dublin)' with a chevron. One closed choice; Combobox adds search, Morph select is labelled.

segmented-control: a 'Time range' control with three segments: 7 days, 30 days, 90 days. Text segments for views; Toggle group is icon toggles.
